highlighted_text.text: Theranos, the company she founded when she was 19 years old, developed a process to run the full scope of medical lab testing using only the smallest sampling of blood
There’s no needles, no hassle and no stress
Everything has been engineered to be as easy and accessible
Theranos offers its tests at 50% of the total Medicaid reimbursement rate, and has begun dropping that price to more that 90% off the typical Medicaid reimbursement rate in certain cases
A complete blood cell count is $4

facts: Elizabeth Holmes is the CEO and founder of medical-testing company Theranos.
Theranos developed a process to run medical lab testing using a small blood sample collected via a finger prick into a nano-tainer.
Test results are made available through a smartphone app and traditional methods.
Theranos tests cost 50% to more than 90% off the total Medicaid reimbursement rate, such as a complete blood cell count costing $4.
Theranos signed a deal with Walgreens to deploy its clinics nationally across its 8,100 stores.
The article was published on October 8, 2014, at the Fortune's Most Powerful Women Summit.
